$comment: The register-pressure half of `deep_stmt_mir`: the same 250-level `if (a)` nest with the result `g` as a LOCAL, so Mem2Reg promotes it and every join merges it in a phi -- a phi chain as deep as the nest, which out-of-SSA copy placement and register allocation must carry through all 250 levels. The sibling keeps `g` global to stay a pure statement-flattening witness; this is the shape it used to avoid because it was once refused (x86 `L_VirtualRegInPostRegalloc` scratch exhaustion; arm64 frame stores past the unscaled imm9 slot). `t()` returns 1 and is DECLARED `__attribute__((noinline))`, and that is load-bearing: without it the shipped release pipeline inlines `t`, folds every condition and the chain disappears (MEASURED 2026-09-19, pe64: 3072 bytes against 18944 with noinline). The `full-release-like` arm runs Mem2Reg with no inliner; the `release` arm is the shipped pipeline. MEASURED 2026-09-19 with noinline: exit 42 on pe64 (native), x86_64 ELF (WSL) and arm64 ELF (qemu), debug and release. Miscompile-sensitive: `g` starts 0 and only the innermost statement sets 42, so a wrong phi input at any join, a lost copy or a mis-slotted reload returns 0, not 42.
